_note: Fins subsystem (FIN) local numbers, owner D3. Read by fusion/fins.py (ctx.local), make_fins.py and team/D3/fins_calcs.py (P:fin_detail.*). Shared numbers (fin station, tube x, tube OD/ID, fin height, TE, motor height, cant, board thickness, layers, spar) come from params/params.json and are not repeated here. Frame: params.json#frame (metres, x aft, y right, z up). Values marked CR are proposals to A1 (team/D3/CHANGE-REQUESTS.md); the module uses them until A1 decides.

tube_length_m.note: CR to A1 (params fins.tube.length_m 0.42): the tube ends 18 mm below the motor axis, under the mount lip cap, so the four motor screws are reachable from behind the plate; the printed mount carries the motor beyond the tube end. Saves 2 x 7.8 g

bond_gap_m.note: radial gap of every printed bore on a 22 mm CF tube (bore 22.3 mm); filled with 30 min epoxy

width_m.note: spanwise, centred on the fin plane; C4 sizes the tube-bore shear-out at 36 mm (CL-C4-BLOCK-MS 0.47); core cut-out (CR-D3-03 to D1)

wall_m.note: PETG wall ahead of the tube bore and behind the spar bore (C4: 6 mm outside each bore)

x_split_m.note: boundary between the flat-topped tube socket (ahead) and the airfoil-contoured spar saddle (aft); mid-web between the bores (web 12.8 mm)

fill_factor.note: 3 perimeters + 15 % gyroid on a 40 x 65 x 30 mm block; weigh the first print

le_gap_m.note: board LE to tube surface, filled by the epoxy fillet

adhesive_kgm2.note: spray adhesive between the two board layers (3M 77 class, ~15 g/m2 wet)

root_joint_g.note: per half-fin: microballoon-epoxy fillets 2 x 0.26 m + skin-tape laps 15 mm up both faces + LE fillet to the tube

top_edge.value: straight line from the station-collar top at the LE to the TE tip at the half height
top_edge.note: the edge strips run along it and end inside the station collar; the LE-top corner under the mount is cut away

half_width_m.note: notch in the LOWER half-fin root centred on the elevon hinge line (x = c (1 - elevon chord_frac)), for D6's inter-panel link (CR-A4-04); D6 confirms the sweep

grip_m.note: collar length on the tube; the lip cap sits on the tube end and the station collar directly below (brace ear as high as possible, CR-C4-04)

cap_t_m.note: C-ring lip that bottoms on the tube end after the slip stroke

cap_lip_r_m.note: inner radius of the lip: covers the 1 mm tube wall

head_clear_m.note: cap top below the lowest motor-screw head (2.5 mm hex key)

slit_m.note: collar split on the outboard side

ear_len_m.note: beyond the collar; pinch bolt M3x16 + nyloc along x

face_ahead_m.note: motor face this far ahead of the collar front so the collar sits >= 39 mm behind the prop plane (CR-B4-04)

pad_h_m.note: canted bearing pads, height at the motor axis; the pad tops lie on the 3 deg canted plane

plate_t_m.note: plate + pads = 4.5 mm under the screw head at the axis (CR-D3-06 to E1: M3x8 gives 3.1-3.9 mm engagement)

pad_centre_m.note: pads centred at (+/-8, +/-8) mm from the axis, 4 x 4 mm: clear of the screw holes, inside a 28 mm base

bolt_pattern_m.note: cross pattern, 16 mm across y, 19 mm across z; not published, E1 measures on arrival (T-E1-MOTOR-RM): drill the plate from the measured pattern

shaft_hole_d_m.note: rear shaft and circlip clearance; UNVERIFIED against the motor

cheek_y_in_m.note: inner face from the fin plane; clears the screw heads (8 + 2.75 = 10.75 mm) and overlaps the collar wall

prop_stack_m.note: motor face to prop plane: can 0.025 + adapter and hub 0.014 (E1 settles)

cant_sense_UR.note: +1: the UR thrust gets a component along +t = x_hat x r_hat (right-handed about +x). Mounts A (UR, LL) and B (UL, LR) are mirror prints; if F4's spin map needs the other sense, swap A and B, no reprint

slip_torque_nm.note: pinch-bolt setting: the collar turns on the tube at this torque (the D-23 fuse, side loads at the motor); set with a luggage scale, BUILD.md step 14

mu_petg_cf.note: PETG on matte CF, dry; only used to estimate the bolt preload, the setting is measured

hardware_g.note: M3x16 SHCS 1.0 + M3 nyloc 0.25 + 2 washers 0.15 per mount

x0_m.note: aft of the clip tails; ESC long axis along x (hover slipstream direction)

z_m.note: |z| of the pad centre: 72 mm from the motor axis, inside the contracted slipstream and below the edge strip

slot_m.note: two strap slots (x by z) for a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap, cut through the board as well

slot_edge_m.note: strap slot edge to pad edge

cf_gcc.note: same basis as the spar's 0.102 kg/m

bond_g_per_joint.note: 30 min epoxy per clip or pad joint

block_bond_g.note: per block: tube bore + spar bore + core faces

fin_detail._note: Design R2 (D3): braced fin per C4 (team/C4/fin_structures.py CALC-C4-MODES-1LB): one-layer board, CF brace from a station collar to the spar, CF edge strips on the top edge, internal tube plug at the block.

layers.note: CR to A1 (params fins.layers 2): C4 recommends one layer + brace + edge strips (CL-C4-SEP-1LB 0.48, CL-C4-MS-FACE-1L 0.28); saves 38 g and pays for the braces. The module uses this value until A1 decides

od_m.note: CF 20 x 18 offcut sanded to slide in the 20 mm bore: internal doubler over the full 47 mm bore (C4: internal plug at every bore)

overhang_m.note: beyond the ends of the bore bosses

height_m.note: directly below the mount collar (0.5 mm gap); carries the LE top of the board, both edge-strip ends and the brace ear

tail_m.note: slot length aft of the tube surface: the edge strips are bonded 20 mm into it

ear_len_m.note: inboard of the collar; holds the brace end in a 3.3 x 10.4 mm slot, 10 mm deep

ear_w_m.note: along x; 2.8 mm walls either side of the 10.4 mm brace slot

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 x 3 mm, 10 mm side along x (cruise flow)

t_m.note: 10 x 3 mm (C4 modelled 10 x 2): with the anchor moved outboard to clear the transport cradles the brace is steeper, the thicker strip restores the lateral axial stiffness (CL-D3-BRACE-KY >= 1)

anchor_y_m.note: |y| of the anchor on the spar line, just outboard of D7's spar cradle and lid pillar (y 0.17-0.23, CR-D3-11): gives the same lateral axial stiffness EA (dy/L)^2/L as C4's brace anchored 0.12 m inboard (CL-D3-BRACE-KY); clear of the elevons (x < 0.2496) and the pod

engage_m.note: strip end bonded into the ear and the anchor slots

len_x_m.note: printed saddle on the spar top, through a 20 x 16 mm pocket in the core and skin (CR-D3-03 to D1)

proud_m.note: above the skin, holds the brace slot

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 x 1 mm on both faces of each half-fin along the top edge, from inside the station collar to the foot

height_m.note: keyhole boss on the block, above the upper skin and below the lower skin: lengthens the tube bore 27 -> 47 mm (root fixity) and holds the board root LE in its slot (replaces separate root clips)

tail_m.note: board engagement aft of the tube surface

slot_clear_m.note: per side, board in the clip slot
